status: Sparse reviewed identity points, including original-track cut leakage; not matcher precision/recall
evidence: 123 original frames, 11 reviewed pages; three samples per proposed track; all 10 Jack and 12 Steve changed-result pages reviewed separately; two exact Tobey camera observations from independent dense review
caveats: Track IDs/indexes refer to these exact frozen snapshots; do not reuse after another detector run.
Unlabelled observations are not negatives. Full runs and final parallels require separate review.
Ambiguous multi-person boxes are reported separately, not counted as a true or false identity.
Steve holdout labels use middle samples; neighboring frames were also reviewed. Identity correctness does not establish useful parallel-scene quality.
